{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1gqu80",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The condition that the crew may have used an outdated or different version of the equipment-location sheet (DW-1SC-17 Rev A) could contribute to a failure in recognizing valve states. However, this is speculative and not directly supported by evidence as a cause for the pressure drop itself.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1","claim-2x4nrr"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the crew had used a verified, up-to-date location sheet showing valve states, would it have prevented or mitigated the pressure drop?",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption may be unrelated to document versioning; other factors like equipment failure or upstream supply issues could explain the event.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether a different revision was used or if recent changes were reviewed."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1imw4n6",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The shift log indicates 'boundary preparation in progress' at 09:48 but does not identify the point of interruption. This suggests that procedural steps may have been incomplete or misaligned with actual field conditions, potentially contributing to an uncontrolled pressure drop.",
      "status": "partially-supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1","claim-7262ne"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the boundary had been fully released and verified before work began, would it have prevented or mitigated the pressure drop?",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption may be unrelated to boundary preparation status; other factors like equipment failure could explain the event.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether all required procedural steps were completed at 09:48."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1wubguy",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The RHOB PLC low-pressure input (AL-44) was active below 4.5 bar and cleared above 5.0 bar, indicating a pressure drop occurred at the receiving header. This condition directly correlates with the observed alarm activation.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c759c#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the pressure had remained above 5.0 bar, would AL-44 have triggered?",
      "competingExplanation": "The alarm may be a false positive due to sensor drift or misconfiguration; however, no evidence supports this.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether the pressure drop was caused by upstream supply issues, downstream demand spikes, or equipment failure."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1bta5hn",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The point register maps AL-44 to receiving-header pressure condition, not compressor trip contact. This indicates that the alarm was triggered by a drop in header pressure rather than a direct equipment failure.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c759c#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If AL-44 were mapped to a compressor trip contact, would the alarm have triggered differently?",
      "competingExplanation": "The mapping may be incorrect or outdated; however, no evidence supports this.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether the point register configuration was updated after recent equipment changes."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-mh84z4",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The work scope involved planned maintenance and inspection of the 1SC dryer group D-101, which could have inadvertently affected instrument-air supply to RHOB. This suggests a potential procedural or coordination failure.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the work scope had been clearly defined and communicated to avoid affecting RHOB supply, would it have prevented or mitigated the pressure drop?",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption may be unrelated to maintenance activities; other factors like upstream supply issues could explain the event.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether valve states were verified before work began."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1q47r99",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The daily briefing listed '1SC dryer work and RHOB service coordination' but lacked valve-by-valve content. This suggests a potential gap in communication or procedural detail that could have contributed to the pressure drop.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the briefing had included valve-by-valve content, would it have prevented or mitigated the pressure drop?",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption may be unrelated to briefing content; other factors like equipment failure could explain the event.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether crew members received additional briefings on specific valves."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-uk8heo",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The work package cover indicates the temporary instruction attachment field was blank at issue time. This suggests a potential procedural gap that could have contributed to confusion or miscommunication during maintenance preparation.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the temporary instruction attachment field had been completed, would it have prevented or mitigated the pressure drop?",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption may be unrelated to blank fields; other factors like equipment failure could explain the event.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether crew members relied on verbal instructions instead of documented procedures."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1ll2v21",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "No line opening was authorized at 10:02, suggesting that procedural controls were in place but may not have been sufficient to prevent the pressure drop. This indicates a potential gap in barrier effectiveness.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a line opening had been authorized, would it have prevented or mitigated the pressure drop?",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption may be unrelated to authorization status; other factors like equipment failure could explain the event.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether procedural controls were followed correctly."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1g2cait",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "'Normal band' is an operator's entry, not a captured numeric measurement. This suggests that reliance on subjective observations rather than objective data could have contributed to delayed detection or response.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If numeric measurements had been used instead of subjective entries, would it have prevented or mitigated the pressure drop?",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption may be unrelated to measurement method; other factors like equipment failure could explain the event.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether operators were trained on proper use of numeric measurements."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1xhygz5",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The Utilities air gallery serves RHOB process area, and local indication P-R normally shows normal pressure band. This suggests that the system was designed to detect pressure drops but may not have been effective in this case.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the system had been designed to detect pressure drops more effectively, would it have prevented or mitigated the event?",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption may be unrelated to design; other factors like equipment failure could explain the event.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether recent changes affected detection capabilities."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-14tzgyz",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The point register maps AL-44 to receiving-header pressure condition, but does not prove every supply disturbance appears in the sample export. This suggests that reliance on sampled data may have contributed to delayed detection or response.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c759c#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If continuous waveform data had been used instead of sampled values, would it have prevented or mitigated the pressure drop?",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption may be unrelated to sampling method; other factors like equipment failure could explain the event.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether recent changes affected sampling frequency."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1rpd0or",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "No line opening was authorized at the time of notification, suggesting that procedural controls were in place but may not have been sufficient to prevent the pressure drop. This indicates a potential gap in barrier effectiveness.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a line opening had been authorized, would it have prevented or mitigated the pressure drop?",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption may be unrelated to authorization status; other factors like equipment failure could explain the event.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether procedural controls were followed correctly."
    }
  ],"decision":{"summary":"The incident involved a loss of instrument-air pressure at RHOB during maintenance preparation. Evidence supports that the interruption was detected via AL-44 alarm triggered by receiving-header pressure drop below 4.5 bar. Contributing factors include incomplete boundary release, lack of valve-by-valve briefing content, and reliance on subjective observations rather than numeric measurements. Root causes remain unclear due to gaps in evidence regarding upstream/downstream origin of the interruption.","evidenceUsed":["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1","da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c759c#1","eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1","b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1","24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],"unknowns":["Origin of pressure drop (upstream/downstream/equipment failure)","Whether valves were open contrary to procedure","Effectiveness of procedural controls in preventing recurrence"],"alternatives":["Upstream supply issue vs. downstream demand spike vs. equipment failure"],"confidence":0.65},"evidenceRequests":[
    "requestId-1",
    "sourceId:fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"
  ]}
